en.headline: 37th Hong Kong Lesbian and Gay Film Festival opens today
en.dek: Asia’s longest-running LGBTQ+ film festival runs until 20 September with 37 features and 38 shorts, grouped by mood rather than genre, at three Broadway Circuit cinemas.
body: The 37th Hong Kong Lesbian and Gay Film Festival opens today and runs to 20 September, presenting what the organisers describe as one of their largest programmes in recent years: 37 feature films and 38 shorts from Hong Kong and overseas.

Instead of sorting titles by genre, this edition groups films under six moods — Love, Laugh, Reflect, Thrill, Pride and Remember — and includes seven short-film programmes. Screenings are at Broadway Cinematheque in Yau Ma Tei, Premiere Elements in Kowloon and Palace ifc in Central. Opening titles listed by the festival include Stop! That! Train! and Montréal, My Beautiful.

The organisers, a registered non-profit, said the festival is now in its 37th year as Asia’s longest-running LGBTQ+ film festival and that guests from overseas and local filmmakers will attend post-screening talks. Regular tickets are priced at HK$100, with an opening-film-and-party ticket at HK$250 that includes entry to an event at Soho House in Sheung Wan.

Tickets are sold at cinema box offices and through the Broadway Circuit website and app. The festival said programme details on its own site take precedence if classifications or session times change.

zh.headline: 第37屆香港同志影展今日開幕 放映至20日
zh.dek: 亞洲歷史最惠久的LGBTQ+影展今年帶來37部長片及38部短片，按心情分類，在百老匯三間戲院放映至9月20日。
body: 第37屆香港同志影展今日開幕，放映至9月20日。主辦單位表示，今年節目規模為近年較大，共有37部長片及38部短片，來自本港及海外。
影展今年改以六種心情歸類作品，分別為愛、笑、思、激、傲及憶，另設七個短片單元。放映場地為油麻地百老匯電影中心、圓方PREMIERE ELEMENTS及中環PALACE ifc。開幕片包括《華麗絲煞列車》及《滿地可人兒》。
主辦單位為註冊非牟利組織，稱影展是亞洲歷史最惠久的LGBTQ+電影節，今年為第37屆，會有海外影人及本地創作人出席映後談。正價票為100元，開幕電影連派對票為250元，包括上環Soho House派對入場。
門票可於戲院票房、自動售票機或百老匯院線網站及應用程式購買。主辦單位表示，若級別或場次有變，以影展網站為準。
